whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Vishakha Bhojnalay,

I noticed your eatery has strong 4.5★ reviews on Exhibition Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for daily meal and takeaway inquiries.

Maine aapke bhojnalay ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp meal booking, daily thali menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/vishakhabhojnalay

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Vishakha Bhojnalay, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp meal booking and a clean menu showcase for Exhibition Road customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact thali items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
